missing_requirement_candidates.description: The client independently requires an image/table caption style with specified typography, but captions are explicitly outside the target Requirement and no caption-specific Requirement exists in the frozen inventory.
The client independently discusses grey visual affordances that show users where to enter content; this is distinct from the underlying editable-field mechanism.
